strings.en: I've no use for small fry!

strings.jp:
こいつを討てれば…
革命は成せる!
strings.en:
If I can take him down...
the revolution will succeed!

Th...the revolution
is not yet won...

strings.jp:
革命だと…?
フン……笑止な!

どうした?　この俺を討つのでは
無かったのか?
strings.en:
What's wrong? Weren't you
to strike me down?

strings.jp:
何だとッ……!?
こんな雑魚ごときに…
strings.en:
What...!?
By small fry like this...
